name: MovieHub Universal Resolver
description: Use local AI to navigate changing websites, learn player routes and prepare reviewable repairs to your actual MovieHub sources.

tools.name: start
tools.description: Start a local AI browser resolve or source repair. For repair, select source_file from the inventory and give diagnosis. Optional url/title adds live browser observations. Returns job_id; poll job for results.

tools.name: job
tools.description: Read a job's progress, media result or proposed source diff. With no job_id lists recent jobs. action inventory returns actual MovieHub provider source paths and current checkout revision. Never call a proposed patch a verified fix.

tools.name: apply
tools.description: Apply a previously reviewed source diff or save a browser recipe; supply the proposal_digest returned by job. rollback restores an applied source patch only when its current hash still matches. Native playback remains unverified.

tools.name: cancel
tools.description: Stop a running local resolver job at the next action boundary. Does not change MovieHub source files.
